tasks.title: An MCP server with the tools from stages 1–2
tasks.dod: Three tools with schemas, one resource and one prompt for contrast; the access level is accepted in the payload. server.py ≤60 executable lines

tasks.title: The stdio client: listing, calling, the failure phases
tasks.dod: list_tools and call_tool work against a real process; a server that did not start and a server that died mid-call give different named phases in finite time; every call leaves a trail in the trace. client.py ≤80 lines

tasks.title: The bridge: a Tool registry out of list_tools, permissions owned by the client
tasks.dod: The stage 3 graph receives its registry from MCP without changing by a single line; a hostile description changes neither the permissions, nor the irreversibility, nor the access; an unknown tool is irreversible by default
